# Antalya VIP Tourism

> Private airport transfers from Antalya Airport (AYT) to hotels in Antalya, Belek, Side, Kemer, Alanya and other destinations. Fixed prices per vehicle (not per person), meet & greet, flight tracking, pay in the vehicle. Mercedes Vito and Sprinter.

## Transfer routes (one-way, per vehicle, EUR)

- [Antalya Airport to Antalya City](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/antalya/): 15 km, 20–30 minutes, from €48 (Vito) / €73 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Belek](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/belek/): 45 km, 35–40 minutes, from €53 (Vito) / €83 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Side](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/side/): 65 km, 55–65 minutes, from €63 (Vito) / €98 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Kemer](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/kemer/): 50 km, 40–50 minutes, from €68 (Vito) / €103 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Alanya](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/alanya/): 125 km, 110–130 minutes, from €108 (Vito) / €158 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Boğazkent](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/bogazkent/): 48 km, 40–45 minutes, from €58 (Vito) / €93 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Manavgat](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/manavgat/): 75 km, 55–65 minutes, from €63 (Vito) / €98 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Manavgat/Kızılağaç](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/kizilagac/): 85 km, 70–80 minutes, from €83 (Vito) / €128 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Tekirova](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/tekirova/): 75 km, 75–90 minutes, from €88 (Vito) / €128 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Bodrum](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/bodrum/): 380 km, 5–6 hours, from €293 (Vito) / €343 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Dalaman](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/dalaman/): 235 km, 3–3.5 hours, from €193 (Vito) / €278 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Fethiye](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/fethiye/): 205 km, 2.5–3 hours, from €193 (Vito) / €278 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Pamukkale](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/pamukkale/): 245 km, 3–3.5 hours, from €263 (Vito) / €313 (Sprinter)
- [Antalya Airport to Cappadocia](https://antalyaviptourism.com/transfers/kapadokya/): 540 km, 7–8 hours, from €343 (Vito) / €363 (Sprinter)
